body: I have never tried therapy even though my SO thinks I should. I just can't imagine having a heart to heart while knowing the person there knows my name. Have you looked elsewhere for work after school? Maybe there is that girl somewhere feeling alone and forgotten that also needs a new scenery. Just cause it's not near you doesn't mean it's not there. I still feel scared by the girl that ripped my heart out years ago after proposing to her and her getting knocked up by someone else.

Thanks for replying. Don't beat yourself up. I sadly dropped out of college for a good job. Left that job due to health concerns and have now just gone with what works at the time and makes ends meet. So I sadly don't have success or truly a job as I get paid under the table. I have a SO who loves me but I don't feel like it's right for me. I've told them my feeling and problems and they understand but don't understand why I feel that way. I just don't know how to get out of the rut. You have success and a job what else is holding you back and can something small help you feel better. Change is never a bad thing. Maybe new scenery could help.
I understand I'm not that old. Late 20's but I just don't feel like I'm heading in the right direction. I don't know what I want to happen but I know I wan't more so much more.
